Enterprise Edition.note: Product edition name; keep in English. Legacy webapp strings sometimes render 'Ediția Enterprise' — prefer the English name.

Team Edition.note: Keep in English; an old webapp string renders 'Ediție de echipă' but edition names should stay untranslated.

Channels.note: Product name; do not confuse with the common noun 'canal/canale'.

System Console.note: Established in webapp ro.json ('consola de sistem'). Genitive: 'consolei de sistem'.

marketplace.note: Webapp ro.json is inconsistent: some labels use 'piața', others keep 'Marketplace'. Keep the English name as the primary rendering (modern Romanian software convention) and treat 'piață' occurrences as legacy.

post.note: Noun; plural 'postări'. Verb: 'a posta'. Avoid the calque 'post/posturi' seen in a few legacy strings ('posturi fixate').

thread.note: Majority rendering in webapp/server ('firul', 'fir de discuție'). Inconsistencies observed: 'subiect' and 'Detalii Mesaj' for the Thread panel title — prefer 'fir' everywhere. Plural: 'fire'.

direct message.note: Plural: 'mesaje directe'. Keep 'DM' untranslated if the abbreviation appears.

mention.note: Noun; plural 'mențiuni'. Verb: 'a menționa'. Use modern diacritics (ț not ţ).

pin.note: 'Fixați pe canal' (mobile), 'mesaje fixate'. Unpin: 'a anula fixarea'. Avoid untranslated 'Pin' seen in one webapp string.

bookmark.note: Noun; plural 'marcaje'. Verb: 'a adăuga la marcaje'. No established repo rendering; standard Romanian UI term.

saved messages.note: Webapp mixes 'mesaje salvate' and 'postări salvate'; prefer 'mesaje salvate'. Save/unsave: 'a salva' / 'a elimina din salvate'.

draft.note: Plural: 'schițe'. No repo signal; standard Romanian software term (Gmail, Teams).

emoji.note: Invariable loanword, already used in webapp ro.json. Plural in running text: 'emoji-uri'.

status.note: Majority rendering; webapp occasionally uses 'statut' ('să vă schimbați statutul') — prefer 'stare' consistently.

do not disturb.note: Established in webapp ('Nu deranjați'). Keep the formal plural imperative.

away.note: Established in webapp; ignore the stray 'Deplasare' mistranslation.

online.note: Kept in English in existing translations; standard in Romanian UIs.

offline.note: Kept in English in existing translations.

out of office.note: Majority webapp rendering; mobile once uses 'Afară din birou' — prefer 'Plecat din birou'.

guest.note: Plural: 'oaspeți'. Webapp mixes 'oaspete' and 'invitat'; prefer 'oaspete' — 'invitat' collides with 'invited' and produces ambiguities like 'Invitați invitați'.

sign in.note: Majority webapp rendering ('vă conectați', 'Conectare'); 'autentificare' also appears — translate both 'sign in' and 'log in' as 'conectare / a se conecta'. Button label: 'Conectare'.

join.note: 'Alăturați-vă canalului'. For join messages, webapp also uses 'intrare' — prefer 'a se alătura' in UI actions.

unarchive.note: Majority webapp rendering ('Dezarhivează canalul', 'Dezarhivați'); ignore the stray 'Canal nearhivat'.

mute.note: Channel notification muting. Existing renderings are inconsistent and poor ('Canal mut', 'muțește') — prefer 'a pune pe silențios' / 'silențios'. Distinct from muting a microphone in Calls ('a dezactiva microfonul').

unfollow.note: 'Nu mai urmăriți firul'. One webapp string wrongly reuses 'Urmărește firul' for unfollow — do not copy it.

favorite.note: Noun/adjective; plural 'favorite'. Verb: 'a adăuga la favorite'; unfavorite: 'a elimina din favorite'.

slash command.note: Established in webapp ('comanda slash'). Plural: 'comenzi slash'.

webhook.note: Keep untranslated (masculine: 'webhook-ul', plural 'webhook-uri'). Legacy machine translations ('bara de intrare', 'bijuteria') are errors — never reuse them.

trigger word.note: Follows webapp 'cuvintele tale de declanșare'. Plural: 'cuvinte de declanșare'.

plugin.note: Kept as loanword in webapp ('pluginul', 'pluginuri'). Articulate as 'plugin-ul' / plural 'plugin-uri' per current orthographic norms.

bot.note: Kept in webapp ('Conturi Bot'). Plural: 'boți' or 'bot-uri'; 'cont de bot' for bot account.

permission.note: Plural: 'permisiuni'. One legacy string uses 'autorizare' — prefer 'permisiune'.

seat.note: Licensed user slot; plural 'locuri'. No repo signal; standard Romanian SaaS term.

workspace.note: Established in mobile ro.json. Plural: 'spații de lucru'.

shared channel.note: Established in server strings. Plural: 'canale partajate'.

message priority.note: Feature name usable as 'Prioritate mesaj' in compact UI.

agent.note: AI assistant; plural 'agenți'. Same word as English.

burn-on-read.note: No repo signal. Label form: 'AUTODISTRUGERE LA CITIRE'; adjectival use: 'mesaj cu autodistrugere la citire' (Telegram-style convention).

personal access token.note: Webapp mixes 'jeton de acces personal' and 'token' — prefer 'token' (established loanword in Romanian tech UI); treat 'jeton'/'indice' as legacy.

username.note: Established in webapp; do not shorten to just 'utilizator' as some legacy strings do.

nickname.note: Legacy strings use 'poreclă' in an example and mistranslate the field as 'Prenume' — prefer 'pseudonim' (standard software term).

data retention.note: Established in webapp: 'Politica de păstrare a datelor' for data retention policy.

compliance export.note: Legacy strings are garbled ('lucrare de complianță') — use 'export de conformitate' consistently.

access control.note: 'Access control policy' = 'politică de control al accesului'.

onboarding.note: No repo signal. 'Inițiere' for the guided first-run experience; the English 'onboarding' is also widely understood in Romanian business software and may be kept in marketing copy.

Town Square.note: Established in server ro.json as the default channel name.

Off-Topic.note: Server ro.json has 'In afara topicului' (missing diacritic, calqued 'topic'); prefer the corrected 'În afara subiectului' but note the existing channel name users may already see.

read-only.note: Existing renderings vary ('numai în citire', 'doar-în-citire', 'doar pentru citire'); standardize on 'doar în citire'.
